title.narrative: Strengthening SDG 3 through Equitable Health Systems and Security

description.narrative:
This project adopts an integrated approach to the development and implementation of inclusive health policies, providing technical assistance, facilitating policy dialogues, developing research briefs, and building consensus through task force and technical working groups. The project will assist the development and implementation of inclusive health policies addressing health equity and health security goals. To avoid duplication, the implementation of the project will be led by member countries, supported by the Secretariat and regional bodies.
